Earth imagery: NASA Earth Observatory, Blue Marble: Next Generation, July 2004. https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/blue-marble-next-generation/base-map/
3D graphics: three.js (MIT license). See vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt.
Book of Mormon relief and shapes: Book of Mormon Wayfinder (https://github.com/foxhollowgames/book-of-mormon), after J. L. Sorenson, Mormon's Map (FARMS, 2000). Illustrative relief, not real elevation.
Flat map: Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD 2-Clause). See vendor/leaflet-LICENSE.txt.
Hub card image (assets/hub-card.jpg): cropped from the same NASA Blue Marble base map.
